leverage_evidence: About text says human and agent write the same persistent board state.

execution_evidence: Three frame sheets show changing visualization and accumulating agent-panel content.
Screenshot and pitch align on shared planning, delegation, and specialist visualization.
impact_rationale: Teams coordinating complex work have a clear need for shared planning and delegation; the live shared-state presentation offers credible value.
impact_evidence: Seven named specialists cover code, research, context, writing, planning, review, and numbers.
Frames/captions show a plan-oriented collaborative workflow.
creativity_rationale: A persistent human-agent plan rendered as a live 3D event-driven workspace is a notably original interaction model pursued beyond chatbot UI.
creativity_evidence: 3D orbital visualization maps board items and specialist routing.

usability_note: Shared board concept is understandable, though dense 3D presentation may add navigation cost.

standouts: Memorable 3D visualization tied to actual plan events.

leverage_rationale: Structured, stage-gated access to live operational state, provenance, plans, and approval boundaries directly changes what an agent can safely do; UI driving is not comparable for incident response.

Frames show checkout restored, operational controls, storefront, and agent timeline.

standouts: Clear safety boundary between investigation and production authority.

one_line: Agent-transparent WebGL map exposing geographic data and spatial actions as tools.

standouts: Use case extends beyond simple click automation to spatial semantics.
